data.name: Baugr Fort
data.description:

data.name: Capital Town Center
data.description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.
Capital Town Centers can detect units stealth or disguises. Pillars near the Viking Capital are slowly revealed to show Saga progress.
data.descriptionCN:
所有资源均可在此存放。可生产村民、侦察兵，并提升最大人口。驻扎时可获得额外攻击。
首都城镇中心可侦测单位潜行或伪装。维京首都附近的石柱会逐步揭示萨迦进度。

data.name: Sacred Grove
data.description:
The Sacred Grove increases the armor of nearby units by +1 and Berserkers are automatically recruited at the Sacred Grove. Can be placed on Sacred Sites and will capture the Sacred Site.
The Sacred Grove health regenerates at 5/s if no enemies are nearby for at least 30 seconds.
Limited to 3 Sacred Groves.
data.descriptionCN:
神圣树林附近单位护甲提升 1，树林会自动招募狂战士。能够放置在圣地上，并占领圣地。
若周围至少 30 秒内无敌人，神圣树林以每秒 5 的速度恢复生命值。
神圣树林最多只能建造 3 座。
